Broiled Salmon with Pesto

--Salmon--
to keep even thickness, remove tail and thin parts
Remove any bones
Sprinkle 1 Tablespoon kosher salt
keep in fridge 1-4 hours

(Set rack 7" from broiling element)

Pat with paper towel
schmere with honey (around 2 tablespoons)

broil at 500 for 6 minutes (Turn halfway through)
Lower heat to 250 for 7.5 - 9 minutes (Turn halfway through)
looking for internal temp of 125

(if gets too dark, cover with aluminum foil)

--Pesto--
1/4 cup almonds
1 chili pepper cleaned
4 garlic cloves

(4 anchovies, rinsed and patted dry)
blitz in food processor for 15 seconds

--Add
6 oz arugula
1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
1/4 cup lemon juice
1.5 teaspoon kosher salt
blitz in food processor for 30 seconds
